verdict.rationale: DBOS's architecture stores all workflow/system state directly in the user's own Postgres database rather than a proprietary store, implying data is inherently in an open, standard format the user already controls (dbos-docs-2, dbos-gh-1, dbos-docs-20). However, there is no explicit documented 'export' feature, data-portability guide, or migration tooling, and community notes highlight that observability/console tooling is not yet self-hostable/open-sourced (dbos-comm-8, dbos-comm-11), which is adjacent but not the same as a full data-export story. Missing for 10: an explicit data export/migration guide, confirmation that all metadata (not just workflow state) is portable, and independent evidence of users actually exporting and leaving.
